subs.gpuOffer: {{gpu}} detected, but Whisper is running on the CPU. Enabling GPU acceleration downloads about 2.5 GB and makes transcription several times faster.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autoPaste: Auto-paste URL from clipboard at startup

cookieBrowser.label: Cookies from browser:
cookieBrowser.warning: Close {{browser}} before downloading — Windows holds a file lock on its cookie database. The app will retry without cookies if the lock blocks the read.

modal.title: Select items from playlist
modal.support: ClipForge is free. Support its development:
modal.bulkBody_one: You are about to download {{count}} file. Continue?
modal.bulkBody_other: You are about to download {{count}} files. Continue?

update.ready: Installer downloaded. Quit ClipForge and run it.

error.forbidden: The site refused the download (HTTP 403). The download engine is probably out of date — check Engine in the console.
error.signin: This video needs a signed-in account. Pick your browser under Settings, Cookies from.
error.unavailable: The video is private, removed, or reserved for members.
error.network: Could not reach the site. Check your connection and try again.
error.format: The requested quality is not available for this video. Try another quality.
error.whisperMissing: Whisper is not available. Restart ClipForge so it can install it.
error.transcribe: Transcription failed. See the console for what Whisper reported.

kurama.auth: The API key was refused. Check it in Settings.
kurama.credits: Your KuramaLab credit is exhausted. Top up to continue.
kurama.model: That model is no longer available. Pick another one.
kurama.rate: Rate limit reached. Wait a moment and try again.
kurama.maintenance: KuramaLab is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
kurama.emptySrt: The subtitle file is empty or not valid SRT.
kurama.empty: The model returned nothing. Try another model — reasoning models often produce no output for this task.
kurama.truncated: The answer was cut off, so cues would be lost. Try a smaller chunk or another model.

engine.label: Engine
engine.stale: yt-dlp {{version}} · {{days}} days old — an update is recommended

preflight.title: Checking components
preflight.checking: Verifying that everything ClipForge needs is installed…
preflight.installing: Installing a missing component. This can take a few minutes the first time.
preflight.needManual: Install these yourself, then press Retry:

install.ytdlp: Reinstall ClipForge: the bundled downloader is missing or was quarantined by antivirus.
install.ffmpeg: Reinstall ClipForge: the bundled converter is missing or was quarantined by antivirus.
install.python: Install Python 3.10+ from python.org and tick "Add Python to PATH"

enhance.title: Improve subtitles with AI
enhance.privacy: The subtitle text is sent to api.kuramalab.net and processed abroad. Transient processing, no prompt logging, no training on your data. Nothing is sent until you press the button.

guide.lede: This uses KuramaLab, a paid service with a small free credit when you sign up. You need your own key.
guide.step2: Generate a key and copy it:
guide.step3: Paste it below. Fixing a 10-minute subtitle file costs a fraction of a cent.

apikey.title: Set up your KuramaLab key
apikey.lede: ClipForge uses KuramaLab to improve subtitles. The key is yours and stays on this computer.
apikey.badShape: A key looks like kl_ followed by 48 characters.
